accepted.review: A calm review scene uses ordinary meals, water, a closed blank folder and blank rigid cards to prioritize checking and recovery without a product, package or claim.
The revised scene keeps both characters complete and uses a closed thick blank folder-board with two small blank rigid cards; it contains no loose pages, labels or regulatory logo.
Two plainly colored unmarked rigid cards and balanced open-palm gestures explain limited risk reduction without a shield, tick, logo or guarantee claim.
A complete, non-glamorized two-person comparison uses only an off-white and pale-blue blank card; there are no stars, crown graphics, advertising panels or duplicate characters.
The simplified scene contains a normal meal, clear water glass and gentle standing reach, without a bed, pillow, supplement product or medical implication.
A dedicated 4:3 kneeling folder-and-card scene differs from the knowledge-page composition and uses a closed blank rigid folder rather than pages.
The overview-only standing comparison uses two completely blank cards and balanced gestures, with no certification badge or claim mark.
The revised overview uses exactly one of each character and two undecorated cards, avoiding imagined scenes, superhero imagery and repeated character depictions.
The distinct 4:3 recovery scene pairs a normal meal and water with a safe lower-body stretch; it contains no package, text, bed or clinical claim.

rejected.reason: Despa's hair touched the top edge and the open folder read as loose pages, failing the safe-margin and rigid-card requirements.
A character's hair touched the top canvas edge, failing the full-subject safe-margin requirement.
The decorative card contained crown and star imagery and the composition cropped the character, introducing advertising-style iconography and edge failure.
The scene accumulated a pillow-like object, mat, bottle, book and dumbbells, making recovery look like an unrelated prop collage and approaching a prohibited bed cue.
The character was too close to the top edge and the open folder appeared as loose pages rather than a rigid file board.
Thought bubbles introduced a duplicate superhero version of Bojji, symbols and a bed scene, violating the exactly-two-character and no-advertising-icon rules.

result: Nine selected source assets passed local visual, alpha and supplement-safety semantic QA. Rejected candidates and their adjusted prompts remain preserved in image-request-log.json.
